title: WHAT IS. FOUNDATION?
short_description: God is light. The prism guides our travel. The tablets carry the ten words. The rainbow is a staircase of light. Guided forward, we become light.
overview_body: The `outline_chain` property is central to each base[span_1](start_span)[span_1](end_span). The `outline_link` property should be able to stand alone and (potentially) constitute a single meeting/session with a disciple[span_2](start_span)[span_2](end_span). The `outline_sublink` is a node hierarchically beneath this and often will include references to other base properties/fields[span_3](start_span)[span_3](end_span). (e.g. it is reasonable that a `mind_movie` in the `mind_movies` array could itself constitute the majority or all of an `outline_sublink`[span_4](start_span)[span_4](end_span). It is also conceivable that an `outline_sublink` could have multiple base property/field references[span_5](start_span)[span_5](end_span). (e.g. `outline_sublink` could have a multiple `base_property_references`: `concept_entry`, `scripture`, `scripture`, `image`, `image`, `video`, `hand_gisture`[span_6](start_span)[span_6](end_span))
